rules.title: California Government Code section 12955 (Fair Employment and Housing Act, housing discrimination; source of income)
rules.requirement: Housing providers may not discriminate against applicants based on source of income, which includes government subsidies such as Section 8 and HUD-VASH vouchers. Where a government rent subsidy applies, income standards must be based on the tenant's portion of the rent, and applicants must be allowed to offer alternative evidence of ability to pay instead of credit history.
rules.status_basis: Amended by Stats. 2023, Ch. 776, Sec. 1 (SB 267), effective January 1, 2024.

requires.name: government_rent_subsidy_for_subdivision_o
requires.text: In instances in which there is a government rent subsidy (applies to the income standard and credit history provisions of subdivision (o))

coverage.summary: Applies to owners of housing accommodations and others in housing transactions, with the subsidy-specific income and credit rules applying where a government rent subsidy exists.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Inquiring about the level or source of income is not source-of-income discrimination, and owners may verify employment, request landlord references or verify identity.
